kinds.title: A public website
kinds.blurb: Marketing, studio, or company site. Heroes, proof, a footer that signs off.
kinds.when: People arrive from the outside. The first viewport has to hold them.

kinds.title: A product or service
kinds.blurb: SaaS, a tool, a service with a price. Data when it earns the screen.
kinds.when: Someone is deciding whether to use you. Clarity over theatre.

kinds.title: A company platform
kinds.blurb: The thing staff live in: ops, admin, a dense home. Density without noise.
kinds.when: People open this every morning. Taste has to survive eight hours.

families.name: Quiet
families.mood: Hairlines, 6px corners, one solid button. The safe default for products that have to last.
rules: Radius 6px on controls, 8px on cards. Never more.
One solid primary. Secondary is outline, same height (40px web / 44px phone).
Hairline borders at 1px. No drop shadows on tables.
Focus ring 2px accent, 3px offset.

families.name: Soft
families.mood: Tonal fills, 14px corners, pills. Friendly without becoming a toy.
rules: Radius 14px on cards, 999px on chips and the primary button.
Primary is a soft accent wash, not a hard fill, unless contrast needs it.
Plenty of air: 24px gaps, 20px card pad.
Phone targets 44px. No hairlines thinner than 1px.

families.name: Sharp
families.mood: Zero radius, visible grid, type that does the work. Swiss without the poster shout.
rules: Radius 0 everywhere. If you round a button you have left the family.
1px ink rules. No shadows. Alignment is the decoration.
Primary can be a solid ink block; hover inverts.
Uppercase 11px labels, 0.12em tracking, on data and nav.

families.name: Editorial
families.mood: Paper, measure, a serif that holds a room. Buttons stay quiet so the type can speak.
rules: Measure 58–66ch on reading. Headlines can break the grid.
Buttons are outlined, 40px, no fill until hover.
Paper grain or warm off-white is allowed; stock photos are not.
Italic is a voice, used once per viewport.

families.name: Glass
families.mood: Translucent bars, 16px corners, things that float. Native feel on the web.
rules: Bars use backdrop-filter: blur(16px) at ~72% opacity. Always give a solid fallback.
Radius 16px on sheets, 999px on tab pills.
Phone chrome: 44px tab bar, home indicator clearance 10px.
Do not glass a whole page. One floating layer is enough.

families.name: Industrial
families.mood: Utility first. Tight type, 2px corners, labels that read like a yard sheet.
rules: Radius 2px. Dense padding (12px). Tables are first-class.
Primary is a committed fill (accent or ink). 36px on web, 44px on phone.
Mono for numbers. Tabular nums. No ornament.
Status colour is reserved for live state, never decoration.

starts.title: A marketing site
starts.blurb: Hero, nav, proof, pricing, FAQ, contact, footer. Assemble a public site from pieces that already agree.
starts.when: A company, studio or product needs a public website with a point of view — not a template.

starts.title: A portfolio
starts.blurb: Index, case study, a horizontal rail, a masthead. Steal a structure, keep your personality.
starts.when: A designer, photographer, architect or studio needs a site that shows the work.

starts.title: A landing page
starts.blurb: One argument, one sitting. Fashion, wellness, fintech, a tool, an agency — each a complete first page.
starts.when: A launch, a waitlist, or a single product that has to land in one viewport.

starts.title: A mobile app
starts.blurb: iOS 26 glass and Material 3 Expressive, plus the PWA moments in between. Native feel, web materials.
starts.when: A phone product that should feel shipped, not like a website squeezed into 390px.

starts.title: A design system
starts.blurb: Start with a language kit, then lock type, colour, icons and motion before drawing a single screen.
starts.when: A new product needs a grammar — tokens and taste — before components.

starts.title: A dashboard
starts.blurb: Dense tables, KPI sparks, a collapsing rail, a board. Density without noise.
starts.when: An internal tool, analytics home, or ops screen people will live in all day.

starts.title: A shop
starts.blurb: Product page, checkout, filters, a luxe detail. Commerce that does not shout.
starts.when: A product, a fragrance, a kit — something people buy without a carnival.

starts.title: An editorial product
starts.blurb: Type does the work: magazine grids, kinetic headlines, a reader with a proper measure.
starts.when: A magazine, a journal, a long-read product where the type is the design.

collections.title: First impressions
collections.blurb: Landing pages, onboarding, empty states and the 404. The screens people meet before they trust you.

collections.title: A website, in parts
collections.blurb: Heroes, navs, features, pricing, proof, contact and the sign-off. Assemble a marketing site from pieces that already agree with each other.

collections.title: Sites that show the work
collections.blurb: Personal and studio portfolios: the index, the case study, the photographer’s rail, the architect’s list. Steal a structure, not a personality.

collections.title: Landing pages with a point of view
collections.blurb: Full first pages for fashion, wellness, fintech, a dev tool and an agency. Each one is a complete argument, not a template.

collections.title: Proof, and the close
collections.blurb: Testimonials, logos, FAQs, stats and the last ask. The blocks that turn a visitor into a customer without raising their voice.

collections.title: Navigation, sorted
collections.blurb: Sidebars, rails, tab bars, drawers and palettes. Every way to get around a product, from a 64px icon rail to a floating glass capsule.

collections.title: Loading states that earn the wait
collections.blurb: Skeletons that match their content, loaders with three elements, buttons that carry their own progress. Nothing spins for the sake of spinning.

collections.title: Sheets, dialogs and things on top
collections.blurb: Bottom sheets with detents, dialogs with real focus traps, toasts that stack, panels that anchor. Layering done with restraint.

collections.title: Forms people finish
collections.blurb: Steppers, inline validation, one-page checkout, sign-in that respects the keyboard. The boring parts, made unboring by getting the details right.

collections.title: Native feel, web materials
collections.blurb: iOS 26 glass, Material 3 Expressive shapes, and the PWA moments in between: install, offline, update.

collections.title: Dashboards and dense data
collections.blurb: Tables you can live in, KPI rows, boards, bento grids and counters that roll. Density without noise.

collections.title: Motion with a reason
collections.blurb: Transitions that explain where things went. Every duration and curve here is doing a job: continuity, hierarchy, or feedback.

collections.title: Typography does the work
collections.blurb: Pieces where the type is the design: editorial heroes, kinetic marquees, reading pages with a proper measure, spreads that behave like print.

collections.title: Whole design languages
collections.blurb: Not a component, a dialect. Each of these is a complete visual grammar you can hand to an agent as the style guide for a product.

collections.title: Cursor and hover play
collections.blurb: Pieces that answer the pointer: magnetic buttons, image trails, letters that get heavier as you approach, cards that tilt and flip.

collections.title: Scroll as the timeline
collections.blurb: Motion tied to scroll position, not the clock: stacking cards, clip reveals, sticky stories, collapsing titles, reading progress.

easings.name: Lounge standard
easings.feel: Decisive, a little heavy at the start, lands clean.
easings.use: Default for UI moves: width, opacity, colour, small translates.

easings.name: Expo out
easings.feel: Fast start, long settle. The “it arrived” curve.
easings.use: Hero reveals, shared-element expands, sheets rising.

easings.name: iOS sheet
easings.feel: Apple’s sheet: almost linear, then a soft stop.
easings.use: Bottom sheets, drawers, large vertical translates.

easings.name: Enter
easings.feel: Same as expo out; named so agents pick it for incoming.
easings.use: Anything that appears: toasts, menus, tooltips.

easings.name: Exit
easings.feel: Leaves quickly. Don’t linger on things going away.
easings.use: Dismissals under 180ms. Pair with enter, never the reverse.

easings.name: Emphasized
easings.feel: Material 3 Expressive. Slow, then a committed finish.
easings.use: Container transforms, FAB morphs, large layout changes.

easings.name: Emphasized decelerate
easings.use: Elements entering a scene in Material language.

easings.name: Emphasized accelerate
easings.feel: Outgoing M3 motion. Leaves with intent.

easings.name: Soft spring (approx)
easings.feel: A polite overshoot. One bounce, then still.
easings.use: Likes, checkboxes, small toggles. Never on layout width.

easings.name: Snappy spring (approx)
easings.feel: Playful overshoot. Use once per screen.

easings.name: Linear
easings.feel: No personality. Correct for loops and progress.

easings.name: In–out cubic
easings.feel: Symmetric. Good when the move will reverse.
easings.use: Theme toggles, accordion height, play/pause morphs.

durations.name: Layout

durations.name: Hero

durations.name: Cinematic

recipes.name: Fade and rise
recipes.note: The Lounge .reveal. Cap stagger at 8 items.

recipes.name: Underline grow
recipes.note: Use a ::after, not text-decoration, so you can ease it.

recipes.name: Sidebar rail
recipes.note: Fade labels out *before* the width finishes so they never wrap.

recipes.name: Sheet up
recipes.note: Dim the scrim on a 240ms linear fade, not the sheet curve.

recipes.name: Dialog in
recipes.note: Focus the first field after the transitionend, not immediately.

recipes.name: Toast enter
recipes.note: Older toasts shift up 8px on the layout curve, not the enter curve.

recipes.name: Tab ink bar
recipes.note: Measure getBoundingClientRect; don’t animate with magic numbers.

recipes.name: Count up
recipes.note: tabular-nums. Never more than four counters on one frame.

recipes.name: SVG stroke draw
recipes.note: Set dasharray to the measured length. Replay resets to length then plays.

recipes.name: Marquee
recipes.note: Duplicate the row so the loop is seamless. Pause on hover.

recipes.name: Like pop
recipes.note: Optimistic: flip state first, then animate.

recipes.name: Page curtain
recipes.note: Hold the outgoing page until the curtain covers, then swap.

recipes.name: Shared expand
recipes.note: One element travels. Don’t fade a new one in on top.

recipes.name: Skeleton to content
recipes.note: Crossfade, don’t pop. Skeleton geometry should match the content.

recipes.name: Magnetic pull
recipes.note: Reset on leave. Never more than 8px of travel.

recipes.name: Theme circle wipe
recipes.note: This is how the Lounge day/night toggle works.

pieces.title: Analytics dashboard overview
pieces.summary: Light analytics overview: four KPI tiles, a single-series area chart drawn as inline SVG with an animated stroke, a crosshair tooltip, a recent-events table and a sliding date-range segmented control.

pieces.title: Avatar stack with presence
pieces.summary: Overlapping initials avatars with a +N overflow chip, hover fans them apart, pulsing green presence dots, name/status tooltips, and a simulated join or leave every 4s.

pieces.title: Bento feature grid
pieces.summary: Six feature cells of varied spans on a 4-column grid, each with a small live CSS illustration; hover lifts a cell 2px and brightens its hairline.

pieces.title: Bottom sheet with three detents
pieces.summary: A draggable places sheet over a CSS-drawn map that snaps to 120px, 430px and full-height detents with spring easing, a progress-linked scrim and velocity flicks.

pieces.title: Brutalist studio home
pieces.summary: Black-on-white studio homepage: 1px column grid, 96px uppercase Archivo Black statement, project rows that invert on hover and a 36-second marquee footer.

pieces.title: Button state morph
pieces.summary: A 220px 'Pay $48.00' button collapses to a 44px spinner in 200ms, draws a checkmark with stroke-dashoffset over 400ms, then expands to a green 140px 'Paid' pill; click again after 2s to replay.

pieces.title: Collapsing sidebar rail
pieces.summary: A 240px app sidebar that collapses to a 64px icon rail with hover tooltips, an accent active-route bar and a ⌘B shortcut.

pieces.title: Command palette
pieces.summary: A ⌘K command palette that opens with a 200ms scale-and-fade, fuzzy-filters 20 grouped commands, and is fully driven from the keyboard with shortcut hints on the right.

pieces.title: Date range picker
pieces.summary: A two-month calendar popover with a presets column, start/end pills, hover-previewed ranges and full arrow-key navigation across month boundaries.

pieces.title: Dense data table
pieces.summary: A 40px-row invoice table with a sticky header, tri-state select-all, shift-click ranges, sortable columns and a dark action bar that slides up when rows are selected.

pieces.title: Documentation three-column layout
pieces.summary: A docs shell: 256px collapsible nav tree, 72ch prose column, sticky 'On this page' TOC with scroll-spy, ⌘K search and a code block with a copy button.

pieces.title: Editorial landing hero
pieces.summary: A paper-toned magazine landing hero: 104px Fraunces headline rising word by word, hairline nav, one-line manifesto, a single outlined pill CTA and a mono issue index.

pieces.title: Editorial mega menu
pieces.summary: A newspaper-style top nav whose full-width panel animates its height between sections, with a 2px underline that slides between labels and a featured story card.

pieces.title: Empty state with line illustration
pieces.summary: An inbox empty state whose line-drawn SVG draws itself over 1.2s, with a heading, one line of guidance, two actions and a transition into a populated list.

pieces.title: Filter chips product list
pieces.summary: A 390px product list with a horizontally scrolling chip row (selected chip grows a check), a sort bottom sheet, a 2-column grid with SVG wishlist hearts, and a shimmer skeleton on every filter change.

pieces.title: Fintech home
pieces.summary: A banking home screen: dark balance card with a 40px tabular amount and a blur-to-hide toggle, four circular quick actions, day-grouped transactions with initial avatars, under a glass top bar.

pieces.title: Floating glass tab bar
pieces.summary: An inset Liquid-glass tab capsule with four tabs and a separate round search island; a glass lens squashes and slides between tabs while content scrolls under it.

pieces.title: Floating tool palette
pieces.summary: A draggable 56px tool palette for a 1180×820 canvas app: five tools with a sliding active indicator, a colour-and-size popover, undo and clear, over a dot-grid canvas you draw on.

pieces.title: Full-screen mobile menu
pieces.summary: A hamburger that morphs into an X while the page fades, the background shifts from cream to navy and five 64px serif links rise in with a 55ms stagger, plus a small-links row and a language switch.

pieces.title: Grouped settings list
pieces.summary: An iOS-style settings screen: inset grouped sections with 44px rows, coloured icon squares, 51×31 spring toggles with a stretching knob, chevron rows with values, footers and a profile row.

pieces.title: Hover tilt cards
pieces.summary: Three pricing cards tilt up to 8° toward the pointer with a cursor-following specular highlight and a lifted shadow, then spring back with an overshoot curve on leave.

pieces.title: Ink-fill upload progress
pieces.summary: A full-screen upload state where a 168px outlined wordmark fills with ink from the bottom via clip-path as progress advances, with a mono percentage, ETA, speed and per-file checks; click replays.

pieces.title: Inline form validation
pieces.summary: A signup form that validates each field on blur with a 6px shake for errors, a stroke-drawn tick for success, a 4-segment password meter and a submit gated until everything passes.

pieces.title: Kanban board
pieces.summary: Four 292px columns with live counts, labelled cards with avatars, pointer-event drag-and-drop with a 3° tilted ghost and a dashed drop placeholder, plus [ ] keyboard moves.

pieces.title: Kinetic type marquee
pieces.summary: Three rows of 136px variable-font text scroll at different speeds and directions; hovering a row eases it to quarter speed; the middle row is outlined and the weight breathes 300–720.

pieces.title: Lamp pull-cord theme toggle
pieces.summary: A hanging brass lamp with a pull cord that switches the whole page between day and night with a radial clip-path reveal starting at the bulb; reduced motion crossfades.

pieces.title: Large title collapse on scroll
pieces.summary: A 34px serif large title shrinks and fades into a 17px centred toolbar title as the list scrolls; the glass toolbar's fill, blur and hairline scale with scroll and the search field collapses.

pieces.title: Luxe product detail
pieces.summary: Fragrance product page: CSS-only bottle with three glass variants, Cormorant serif name, a size radio with a sliding black indicator, and an Add to bag button that morphs to a gold Added state.

pieces.title: Luxe serif design style
pieces.summary: High-contrast Cormorant Garamond with Karla small caps, hairline gold rules, cream and charcoal surfaces and centre-out underlines; a nav, four buttons, a newsletter input, a product card and a quote.

pieces.title: M3 expanding FAB menu
pieces.summary: A dark-tonal Material 3 Expressive FAB that rotates its plus 45°, rounds to a circle and unfurls three labelled pill actions with a 40ms stagger behind a scrim.

pieces.title: M3 Expressive home feed
pieces.summary: A warm-tonal Material 3 Expressive home: 36px greeting, morphing segmented group with a shape loader, 28px tonal cards, a floating 5-action toolbar and an extended FAB.

pieces.title: M3 modal navigation drawer
pieces.summary: A 360px Material 3 Expressive modal drawer that slides in under a scrim from a top-app-bar hamburger, with full-width tonal pill for the active item, section headers, dividers and badges.

pieces.title: M3 search bar morph
pieces.summary: A Material 3 Expressive container transform: a 56px pill search bar in a dark top app bar grows into a full-screen search view (radius 28→0) with suggestions fading in; the back arrow reverses it.

pieces.title: Magazine editorial grid
pieces.summary: An asymmetric 12-column editorial front: a 7-column lead story, three sidebar stories, a numbered index that highlights its story on hover, and hairline rules throughout.

pieces.title: Masonry gallery with captions
pieces.summary: A 4-column CSS-columns masonry of 14 CSS-painted tiles; hover slides a caption bar up from the bottom, and a chip row filters by series with a fade.

pieces.title: Mobile landing with sticky CTA
pieces.summary: A 390px marketing landing page: Fraunces headline, scroll-snap feature carousel, social-proof block, FAQ accordion and a CTA bar that slides up once the hero scrolls away.

pieces.title: Modal dialog with focus trap
pieces.summary: Native <dialog> modals that open with a 240ms scale .96→1 and scrim fade, trap focus, close on Esc or scrim click, plus a destructive variant gated by a type-to-confirm input.

pieces.title: Multi-step form stepper
pieces.summary: A three-step workspace setup with a horizontal stepper whose connectors fill on completion, direction-aware 40px slide transitions, validation on Continue and a review step with Edit links.

pieces.title: Neo-brutalist design style
pieces.summary: Thick 2.5px black borders, hard 4px 4px 0 offset shadows, flat yellow and blue fills, and hover that moves the element into its shadow; buttons, inputs, a card, toggles and tags.

pieces.title: Nested dropdown menu
pieces.summary: An application menubar with click-to-open menus, hover submenus guarded by a safe-triangle delay, check and radio items, a shortcuts column and complete keyboard support including typeahead.

pieces.title: Notification center panel
pieces.summary: A bell with an unread dot opens a 380px top-right panel with All/Mentions/Following tabs, Today/Yesterday groups, unread dots that scale away on Mark all read, and an empty tab state.

pieces.title: Now playing
pieces.summary: A full-screen player: CSS-gradient album art with SVG grain, the same art blurred as the backdrop, a scrubber with a fat drag thumb, a path-morphing play/pause and time-synced lyrics.

pieces.title: Odometer counter
pieces.summary: A 112px revenue figure whose digits roll vertically on 0–9 strips (700ms expo-out, 24ms cascade from the right), with comma grouping, four add/refund buttons and a 3s auto-tick.

pieces.title: Onboarding carousel
